entities.summary: Duarte Coelho Pereira was a nobleman, military leader, and colonial administrator in the Portuguese colony of Brazil. Born around 1502, he was the son of a noble family and received a good education. In 1534, he married Ana de Sousa, a woman from a wealthy family, and they had several children together. Duarte Coelho Pereira was the first Donatario of the captaincy of Pernambuco and founder of Olinda, which became a key city in the Portuguese colony. He played a crucial role in the establishment of the colony and was instrumental in the development of the city of Recife. Duarte Coelho Pereira died on August 7, 1554, at the age of 52. His legacy continued to shape the colony, and he is remembered as a key figure in the early history of Brazil. The city of Olinda, which he founded, remains a significant cultural and historical landmark to this day.
